audio_ui_off_note.message: Processing is OFF: settings can be edited and saved, but are not applied to the sound.

audio_ui_comp_reference.message: Static input/output dB, not measured loudness

audio_ui_eq_reference.message: 48 kHz · Q=1 · Reference excludes Gain and safety attenuation

audio_ui_default.message: Enable processing automatically for new videos

audio_ui_dial_hint.message: Drag vertically · double-click to reset · numbers/arrow keys

audio_ui_target_missing.message: Reopen settings from the intended broadcast.

audio_ui_resume_hint.message: Use the processing button in the broadcast. The settings tab cannot transfer playback activation.

audio_ui_advisory.message: Current broadcast advisory status, not a measurement of audio output.

audio_ui_target_changed.message: The original broadcast document changed or is unavailable. Read again explicitly; no automatic retry.

audio_ui_create_expired.message: The source settings changed. The name is kept. Reopen the creation section to capture a new source.

audio_ui_create_ready.message: Create from the confirmed settings captured on entry.

audio_ui_gain_unconfirmed.message: Site Gain is unconfirmed. Store Gain explicitly or read/import it before preparing this preset.

audio_ui_upgrade_note.message: Only upgrades stored data; does not turn on processing in the current broadcast.

audio_ui_legacy_limited.message: Reading/importing site Gain requires a verified live channel. For VOD, save Gain directly.

media_confirm_apply.message: Apply this preset and replace the stored settings?

media_confirm_upgrade.message: Upgrade existing channel and preset data to the new format?

media_confirm_gain_inherit.message: Use inherited global/site Gain instead of this stored Gain?

media_confirm_gain_import.message: Store the read site Gain globally? Channels inheriting global Gain will also use it.

media_entry_guide.message: Edit channel-specific audio and video in a separate tab. Other settings remain global.

media_global_guide.message: Only the audio compressor and video filters are channel-specific. Other controls are global.

media_target_invalid.message: Invalid target. Only global and saved-channel management is available.

media_target_changed.message: The original tab, window or channel changed. Reopen from that broadcast.

media_open_failed.message: Could not open settings in the original window. Incognito and closed windows are unsupported.

ext_description.message: An unofficial community recovery of Cheese Knife, providing viewing tools for CHZZK.

config_previewStartUnmuted_desc.message: Start the next sidebar preview at the configured volume when it appears. If the browser blocks automatic sound, play muted instead. Does not affect the main broadcast.

content_previewAudioBlocked.message: The browser blocked automatic sound. Playing muted.

content_previewAudioRightClick.message: Right-click the sidebar target to unmute.

config_rightClickToUnmute_desc.message: Right-click the active sidebar preview target to toggle mute. Does not modify CHZZK's native previews.

config_previewDelay_desc.message: Play the preview after the specified amount of time has elapsed.

config_popupPlayer_desc.message: Dragging a channel from the sidebar will open the player in a small window.

config_arrowSeek_desc.message: Rewind a short time in the live.

config_pressToFastForward_desc.message: Long-press in VOD to play at 2x speed.

config_category_videoFilter_desc.message: Double-click to set to the default value.

config_sharpness_warning.message: Hardware acceleration is required. Click to go to settings.

config_category_compressor_desc.message: Double-click to set to the default value. The compressor can be activated by pressing the button next to the volume, and the gain can be adjusted with the slider.

config_compressorThreshold_desc.message: The decibel value above which the compression will start taking effect.

config_compressorKnee_desc.message: The higher the value, the more smoothly the compressor runs.

config_compressorRatio_desc.message: The ratio by which to reduce the loudness of the sound.

config_compressorAttack_desc.message: The amount of time it takes for the gain to decrease when it gets louder.

config_compressorRelease_desc.message: The amount of time it takes for the gain to increase again when it gets quieter.

permission_desc.message: Thank you for installing Cheese Knife! This extension requires the following permissions:

permission_host.message: Access $HOST$ (features and styles on HTTPS CHZZK pages)

permission_denied.message: Permission was not granted. Select Allow to try again.

permission_failed.message: Could not complete the permission request. Please try again.

styles_fit_player_desc.message: Relaxes player-container height limits. VOD uses space reserved for the information row. Does not enter fullscreen, crop or zoom video, or change quality.

capability_reason_scoped_config_pending.message: Waiting for the current channel's media settings.

capability_reason_scoped_config_unavaila.message: Channel settings could not be confirmed; global settings are used. Reload the broadcast tab after an extension update.

capability_reason_profile_limited.message: Settings metadata could not be confirmed. Only valid media values are applied; damaged source data is not overwritten.

capability_reason_reload_required.message: The current tab's execution code is incompatible with this extension. Reload the broadcast tab.

capability_reason_generic.message: Part of this feature is unavailable on the current page.

capability_reload.message: Open a CHZZK tab and reload it after updating the extension.

capability_reason_user_gesture_required.message: Click the compressor button again to activate audio.

capability_reason_unsupported_media_sour.message: This media source cannot safely be connected to the audio effect.

capability_reason_internal_metrics_unava.message: Resolution and measured FPS are shown; unavailable internal metrics are marked unknown.

capability_reason_age_restricted_stream.message: Age-restricted streams are not played in previews.

settings_saving.message: Saving settings. Apply to the page after saving finishes.

settings_failed.message: The settings operation failed. Held input is not automatically resent.

settings_unknown.message: The save result is unknown. Input is not automatically resent; a sent save cannot be cancelled.

settings_repair_required.message: The stored revision needs repair. Settings will not be overwritten.

settings_css_failed.message: Settings are saved, but CSS registration failed. Reapply CSS before applying to the page.

settings_discard.message: Discard held display values · Check saved state

settings_global.message: Settings are shared across CHZZK tabs. Reload other open pages manually to apply styles; other tabs are never automatically reloaded.

settings_target.message: Apply reloads only the original CHZZK tab captured when these settings were opened.

settings_no_target.message: No target tab. Global settings can still be saved; reload the CHZZK page manually.

settings_target_changed.message: The target tab is missing or its site/window has changed. Reopen settings from the CHZZK tab.

media_draft.message: Held intent and latest saved values · read-back never saves automatically. Discard displayed intent and check current values before re-editing.

media_refresh.message: Check current saved values · read only

settings_reconnect_required.message: This settings document is disconnected and cannot edit. A save already sent may have completed. Review the retained intent before reloading this settings tab.

settings_reconnect_confirm.message: Reload only this settings tab? Remaining input may be lost and a save already sent may have completed. The new document will read the actual saved values.

media_confirm_reset.message: Delete this channel's saved domain and use global values? Other domains and global values stay unchanged.

media_confirm_channel.message: Delete this channel's audio and video settings? Other channels and global values stay unchanged.

media_confirm_preset.message: Delete the selected preset? Values already copied to channels or global settings stay unchanged.

media_preset_name.message: Local preset name · up to 48 characters

media_ready.message: Saved media values confirmed. Channel settings affect audio/video only.

media_saving.message: Saving. Scope changes are blocked until confirmed.

media_unknown.message: Save outcome unknown. Read back or discard displayed intent; neither resends nor rolls back the save. Equal saved values alone do not confirm the original commit.

media_failed.message: Operation failed. Held input is preserved and not resent.

media_conflict.message: Stored settings changed. Review saved values before trying again.

media_repair_required.message: Channel/preset data needs repair. Global settings remain available.

media_unavailable.message: Channel context unavailable. Reopen from the intended broadcast; global settings remain available.
